I built a Grok Bot that transcribes your audio and video on your own computer. It runs several Whisper models side by side, so you can see where they disagree and which one dropped speech. It's free, private, and needs no API keys.

Grab the template: https://t.co/ru5ufQFpb8

— Jeff B. 🥩 (@jeffasu) October 1, 2026
